parts.text: 9 This question is about what happens when a car overtakes a truck. The diagrams are not to scale. In these diagrams, the direction of travel is from left to right. The car has length 5 metres. The truck has length 15 metres. The car moves into the outside lane to overtake the truck when there is a gap of 45 metres between the front of the car and the back of the truck. Outside lane Inside lane 5 m 15 m 45 m The car moves back into the inside lane when there is a gap of 50 metres between the back of the car and the front of the truck.
